name: print-social-purple-events-brand-post-collage
title: Purple ticketing brand posts in rounded phone-like cards with yellow pill
whatItIs: A deep purple portfolio cover with a large cream 'Social Media Designs' title, a yellow pill naming the brand, and eight post cards in rounded corners showing crowds, portraits and event photos with purple overlays, bold headlines and white footers.
whatItMeans: Vibrant and communal; purple gradients and yellow accent feel like nightlife and celebration.
techniques: Show posts as rounded cards fanned across the bottom of a cover.
Highlight the client name in a yellow pill.
Wrap photos in purple gradients for consistency.
Use a glowing title with soft shadow.

vocabulary.definition: Multiple posts arranged as a spread.
A purple gradient overlay on photos.
A cover slide summarising a body of work.
